name: open-artifact
description: Make an Open Artifact (a slide deck, a design canvas, a whiteboard, a data dashboard, a doc, …) as a folder of files that opens as a live local page where the person views, edits, comments and exports, with their comments coming back to you. Use when the person types `/open-artifact <type> <what to make>`, or asks for something they will look at closely, keep, change, comment on or present - a presentation, pitch or talk deck; app screens, a mockup, a landing page, a poster, flyer or graphic, or
author: JimLiu
